description: Reopen r-sort-3b-nulls (General) read-only. Table-type walks reading ID of NI1 with no Index, and of index IX forward and backward on NI1 (K IGNORE NULL), NI2 (K), NI5 (K DESC IGNORE NULL), NI6 (K DESC), NR1 (K IGNORE NULL built after the rows) and NU4 (unique K DESC IGNORE NULL). Asks whether rows with a Null or empty K are visible in an index walk with and without IGNORE NULL, in an ascending and a descending index, built before or after the rows, and where they are placed.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
